articles.title: Sebastián Lelio was a fascinating film-maker of great passion and poetry
articles.summary: Chilean director of films including Gloria and A Fantastic Woman could expertly capture both the personal and political

articles.title: Sebastián Lelio, director of A Fantastic Woman and Gloria, dies aged 52
articles.summary: The Chilean film-maker, whose films starred Florence Pugh, Julianne Moore and Rachel Weisz, died at his home in Santiago

articles.title: The Cat in the Hat review – Bill Hader brings plenty but this animated rework is a mess
articles.summary: The SNL alum has an appealing energy and this is an improvement on the 2003 travesty but it’s also far too long and strangely corporate

articles.title: If Dune is this generation’s Star Wars, we are all in big trouble
articles.summary: According to Florence Pugh, Denis Villeneuve’s stunningly strange and breathtaking universe is the equivalent to George Lucas’ heroic space opera. Let’s hope not

articles.title: Rocky review – 50 years on, Stallone’s boxer remains an exhilaratingly gritty contender
articles.summary: The actor’s triumphant breakthrough has clear ancestors in grimy tales of working-class struggle, but finds a fresh, rousing idealism

articles.title: Elke Sommer obituary
articles.summary: Glamorous star of 1960s films best known for her role opposite Peter Sellers in A Shot in the Dark

articles.title: Raise the Red Lantern review – Gong Li gives a decade-defining performance in an addictively ruthless masterpiece
articles.summary: Gong simmers with rage, loneliness and humiliation as the ‘fourth mistress’ navigating the intimate political savagery of her husband’s compound in Zhang Yimou’s 1991 drama

articles.title: I Play Rocky review – Anthony Ippolito adds knockout sweetness to the story of Stallone’s Hollywood triumph
articles.summary: Portraying the humour, passion and grit that took the actor from bit parts to Oscar glory, this making-of tale is even more mythic than the original movie
